_comment: GAP-2 ADEQUACY MANIFEST — the fixed point of the adequacy verification track.
This is INDEPENDENT of release/manifest.json (which pins the v1.0.1 released artifact).
The GAP-2 spec chain has its own root, Cjson.Spec, and is NOT imported by Cjson.lean, so
the released artifact stays byte-identical to v1.0.1. harness/gap2/check_gap2.py fails if
the source and this manifest disagree in either direction (a '-- @attested-gap2 <name>'
marker absent here, or a name here absent/unprovable in source), if any listed declaration
gains an axiom outside allowed_axioms, if the pinned Grammar Prop text changes, or if the
sha256 over the exact byte range of Grammar.lean holding the C1-C5 candidate Props plus
the SDoc/SAccepts/DepthOk definitions they reference. Any edit to the frozen spec Props
changes this hash and fails the gate, so a theorem's MEANING cannot drift by silently
editing the spec it is pinned against. Regenerate deliberately with --update-grammar-pin.
grammar_prop_pin.start_marker: def DepthOk (v : JSON) : Prop := jdepth v ≤ nestingLimit
grammar_prop_pin.end_marker: example : Prop := ∀ s, ¬ SAccepts s → parseDoc s = none

released_artifact_untouched._comment: These released files MUST remain byte-identical to tag v1.0.1; check_gap2.py asserts it.
